title: Multi-dimensional deep learning drives efficient discovery of novel neuroprotective peptides from walnut protein isolates.
summary: Four walnut-derived peptides received behavioral and biochemical validation; no human neuroprotective efficacy established.

evidence.tested: Four walnut-derived peptides received behavioral and biochemical validation; no human neuroprotective efficacy established.
evidence.unknown: The date refers to the cited version. Earlier public versions and independent replication were not systematically verified.
evidence.ai_role: MiCNN-LSTM is the AI method documented in the editorial source review.
